context: Ren reports a funded project to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (相当/いただく/実践/追加/資本) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新事業に、相当の資本が集まりました。
lines.en: Considerable capital gathered for the new venture.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 追加の資本も、必要かね?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少し追加すれば、実践に移せます。
lines.en: With a little addition, we can put it into practice.
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 出資者の理解は、いただけたかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、快く了承をいただきました。
lines.en: Yes, we received their ready consent.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 相当な期待が、寄せられているな。
lines.en: Considerable expectations are being placed on us.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 追加資本を活かし、実践します。
lines.en: Using the added capital, we'll execute.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 相当の覚悟で、進めてくれ。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
